how.title: Me pēhea te tikiake
how.step1.title: Tāruatia te hono
how.step1.text: Huakina te pou i roto i te taupānga, pātōtia Tiri, kātahi ka kōwhiri i Tārua hono.
how.step2.title: Whakapiria ki konei
how.step2.text: Whakapiria te hono ki te pouaka i runga ake, kātahi ka pēhi i Tikiake.
how.step3.title: Kōwhiri, ka tiaki
how.step3.text: Kōwhiria he ataata, he oro MP3, he whakaahua rānei i te kounga e hiahia ana koe.
platforms.title: Ngā pūhara e tautokohia ana
platforms.lead: He ataata, he whakaahua, he oro mai i ngā rau pae. Ko ētahi o ngā mea rongonui rawa:
faq.title: Ngā pātai auau
faq.q1: He kore utu a I Need Save?
faq.a1: Āe, he kore utu katoa. Kāore e hiahiatia he rēhitatanga, he takiuru, he taupānga rānei.
faq.q2: Ka tiakina ōku kōnae ki hea?
faq.a2: I Android me ngā rorohiko, ka haere ngā kōnae ki te kōpaki Ngā Tikiake. I iPhone me iPad (Safari), ka tiakina ki te taupānga Kōnae → Ngā Tikiake. Mai i reira ka taea e koe te tiaki ki Whakaahua mā te pātene Tiri.
faq.q3: He aha e kore ai e taea ētahi ataata te tikiake?
faq.a3: Kāore e taea e tō mātou tūmau te toro atu ki te ihirangi tūmataiti, ki te ihirangi e hiahia ana kia takiuru, ki te ihirangi kua herea ā-rohe rānei. Kia mōhio he tūmatanui te pou, kātahi ka ngana anō.
faq.a4: Ka oti te hono te tukatuka, kōwhiria te kōwhiringa MP3 i raro i te Oro. Ka tangohia te oro i te ataata, ka hurihia hei MP3 192 kbps.
faq.q5: He tohu wai kei ngā ataata TikTok?
faq.a5: Ka hiahia tonu mātou ki te putanga kāore he tohu wai, ina wātea ana. Ko ngā kōwhiringa he tohu wai kei roto kua tapaina ki te Tohu wai.
faq.q6: Ka tiakina ōku kōnae ki tō koutou tūmau?
faq.a6: Kāo. Ka tukuna tika ngā kōnae mai i te pūhara taketake ki tō pūrere, ā, kāore e puritia ki tō mātou tūmau.
